title: Number of Sub-arrays of Size K and Average Greater than or Equal to Threshold
summary: Given an array of integers, and two integers k and threshold, return the count of sub-arrays of size k whose average is at least threshold.
statement: Given an array of integers, and two integers k and threshold, return the count of sub-arrays of size k whose average is at least threshold.
constraints: Count length-k subarrays whose average is at least threshold.
Inputs are nonnegative and 1 <= k <= len(arr).
reference_solution:
def qualifying_fixed_average_count(arr, k, threshold):
 total=sum(arr[:k]);answer=int(total>=k*threshold)
 for i in range(k,len(arr)):total+=arr[i]-arr[i-k];answer+=total>=k*threshold
 return answer
